implemented: Canonical initial A commitment uses a full causal original-source scan per coset instead of invoking the 128-byte scalar getter per coefficient.
Source-row coverage bitmaps and per-source tile indices preserve original biased-byte layout; consumer errors propagate immediately.
Only selected large initial W/A geometry is admitted: 128 base columns, 2^22 coset rows and 2^12 Merkle cut.
Base cosets scatter directly into one column-major buffer; one FFT column is reused without a full row-major copy.
Both P3 twiddle tables are retained across cosets; factored powers preserve original pad positions and nonmonotone producer order.
Query batch policy is shared between Code and Tree: reduced cap 1024 retained, selected large initial cap 2^21 connected but not exercised.

reduced_initial_fixture.reference: Independent native HidingWhirProver dense commitment with the same private pad and salt seeds.

targeted_component_checks: Odd/even shuffled emission order, rows 16/32/64/128, nonzero original pads and live prefix shorter than the message; equality with the original coset encoder.
Reject omitted coefficients, out-of-live emission, source error and invalid coset geometry.
Reduced byte partition emits each i16/i32/i48 byte once and equals the independent virtual-to-packed address map; consumer error stops after one byte.
Canonical synthetic softmax operator scans frozen score checkpoint, D/E/Z/Pi and complete histogram, including public internal padding; coverage and error propagation.
Retained initial root/cache, Merkle salts and RNG fork/seek, query remainders/zero-tail split, original MACs, full reduced sourcewise WHIR transcript and ordered reduced O=0 pipeline.
Canonical metadata/row fixtures for three contexts; no full-model numerical execution.

static_geometry_no_large_allocation.resource_note: Analytic payloads only, not a simultaneous physical peak. Excludes source workspace, metadata/capacity, power tables, row coverage, checkpoint/KV/histograms, Merkle frontier/salts/cache and other owners. Both twiddles remain live across cosets; power tables are dropped before the FFT column is allocated.
